title: SuppliedTake
description: One user-supplied MP4 shot for one approved storyboard scene (engine/SPEC.md Phase 3; M2Radar_Content_Engine_Full_Execution_Prompt_v4.md §82). One entry in `takes[]` of the `cards/takes/<card_id>.json` sidecar (see cards/README.md's sketch of that file) and the row shape `engine.production.validate_take`/`ingest_takes` check and enrich. Fields the shooter/loader supplies by hand are required and non-null; fields `engine.production.probe_media` derives from the MP4 itself (duration_s, fps, width, height, has_audio, sha256) are required keys but stay null until a real file has been probed — never invented.

card_id.description: cards_v2.card_id this take belongs to, e.g. C-2026-09-11-01.

scene_id.description: Must match a scene_id already present in cards/<card_id>.json's storyboard[].

script_segment.description: The script.sections[].role (or a short quote of script_text) this take delivers — business-readable anchor back to the frozen script, not a foreign key.

take.description: Take number for this scene_id, 1-based; repeated shots of the same scene increment this.

shot_type.description: Free-text shot description (e.g. 'A_ROLL_CLOSE_UP', 'screen recording, dashboard'); not the closed frame_type vocabulary — what the operator actually shot, in their own words.

roll.description: A = presenter/talking-head footage, B = cutaway/insert footage.

duration_s.description: Probed clip duration in seconds. Null until engine.production.probe_media has run against an existing file at `path`.

fps.description: Probed frame rate. Null until probed.

width.description: Probed pixel width. Null until probed.

height.description: Probed pixel height. Null until probed.

orientation.description: Declared/observed orientation. engine.production.validate_take flags anything other than 'portrait' as an error — every M2Radar card is a 9:16 reel.

has_audio.description: Whether the probed file carries an audio stream. Null until probed.

audio_quality.description: Operator's own assessment of the recorded audio, logged at supply time.

subject.description: Who/what is on camera, e.g. 'Misha, presenter' or 'laptop screen, ranker dashboard'.

in_s.description: Intended in-point (seconds) inside the supplied clip for the trimmed edit.

out_s.description: Intended out-point (seconds). Must exceed in_s and, once duration_s is known, must not exceed it.

sync_notes.description: Free text for the editor, e.g. 'clap at 0.0s, aligns with script beat hook'. May be an empty string.

quality_status.description: PENDING = not yet reviewed; OK = usable, select_takes() may choose it; RETAKE = rejected, a new take should follow with retake_of pointing back here.

retake_of.description: The take number this one re-shoots, when quality_status of that earlier take was RETAKE. Null for a first attempt.

sha256.description: sha256 of the file at `path`. Null until probed (probe_media hashes the file it just measured).

path.description: Path to the supplied MP4, relative to the repository root (e.g. cards/takes/C-2026-09-11-01/S01-take1.mp4). May point at a file that does not exist yet — ingest_takes reports that explicitly rather than failing silently.
